Paper: Comparative analysis of audio classification with MFCC and STFT features (2024)
Dataset: UrbanSound8K (8732 samples), Sound Event Audio Dataset (1288 samples)
Classification Method: Artificial Neural Network (ANN), Logistic Regression, K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN)
Accuracy / Results: 91.27% accuracy with ANN, KNN performed poorly on noisy samples
Key Contributions / Findings: Comparison of MFCC and STFT features, ANN achieved highest performance for noisy environment sound classification

Paper: Enhancing Audio Classification Through MFCC Feature Extraction (2024)
Models: CNN (15 layers), RNN (9 layers) with LSTM
Features: 13 MFCCs, Mel-Spectrogram with 128 Mel bands, data augmentation (pitch shifting, noise)
Classification Method: Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) with LSTM
Accuracy / Results: 96.52% for CNN, 92.89% for RNN on ESC-50 dataset
Key Contributions / Findings: CNN outperformed RNN on smaller datasets, while RNN performed better on larger datasets (e.g., ESC-50)

Paper: Speech/Music Classification Using Block Based MFCC Features (2012)
Dataset: GTZAN Music/Speech Dataset (128 audio files, 64 music, 64 speech)
Models: SVM with Radial Basis Function (RBF) kernel
Features: Block-based MFCC (40 filter banks, 3 frequency bands), delta and delta-delta features
Accuracy / Results: 98.43% accuracy using block-based MFCC with SVM
Key Contributions / Findings: Block-based MFCC achieved superior performance with SVM compared to traditional MFCC

Paper: Music Classification based on MFCC Variants (2012)
Dataset: Custom music database (837 audio files, 30-45s each)
Features: MFCC (13 coefficients), Wavelet-based features (Haar decomposition, STE)
Classification Method: RANSAC (Robust Estimation), MLP, SVM for hierarchical classification
Key Contributions / Findings: Hierarchical classification with MFCC variants and wavelet-based features significantly improved accuracy for instrumental and genre classification

Paper: Speech/Music Classification Using MFCC and KNN (2017)
Dataset: Custom dataset of 600 audio clips (300 music, 300 speech, 1-10s each)
Features: 13 MFCC features, frame size 20 ms, frame shift 10 ms
Accuracy / Results: 91% accuracy using KNN, performance consistent across different audio clip lengths
Key Contributions / Findings: KNN with MFCC features is a lightweight, effective model for speech/music classification

Paper: Knowledge Transfer from Neural Networks for Speech-Music Classification (2021)
Dataset: MUSAN (660 music files, 426 speech files), GTZAN, Marolt19, ACMusYT
Models: INA (CNN-based), SwishNet (residual CNN), VGG-like CNN, OpenL3 embeddings
Features: 21-22 MFCCs, Mel-Spectrogram, OpenL3 embeddings from pre-trained models
Classification Method: Transfer learning with CNN, RNN, OpenL3 embeddings, fine-tuning on specific tasks
Accuracy / Results: 99.2% accuracy with OpenL3 embeddings for speech/music classification
Key Contributions / Findings: OpenL3 embeddings consistently outperformed CNN and RNN models for various tasks, demonstrating the effectiveness of transfer learning

Paper: Audio Classification in Speech and Music (1999)
Dataset: FM radio station dataset (30 minutes of audio, alternating 5-min speech/music segments)
Models: MLP with 15 hidden neurons, Gaussian classifier for ZCR features
Features: Zero-Crossing Rate (ZCR), Spectral flux, Short-Time Energy (STE), Cepstral coefficients
Classification Method: Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) for 5-class audio categorization, Gaussian classifier for ZCR
Accuracy / Results: MLP achieved 6% Total Error Rate, significantly better than ZCR-based methods
Key Contributions / Findings: MLP classifier performed significantly better than ZCR-based Gaussian classifiers for speech/music discrimination

Paper: MFCC Based Audio Classification Using Machine Learning (2021)
Dataset: RAVDESS (576 training samples, 192 testing samples, 24 actors)
Models: Random Forest (100 trees), SVM (RBF kernel), Decision Tree
Features: 13 MFCC features, Periodogram, Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT)
Classification Method: Random Forest, SVM, Decision Tree classifiers
Accuracy / Results: 88.54% accuracy for Random Forest on RAVDESS dataset, SVM and Decision Tree performed lower
Key Contributions / Findings: Random Forest was the best performer for emotion classification on the RAVDESS dataset, while SVM struggled with multi-class emotion data

Paper: Speech/Music Classification Using Phase-Based and Magnitude-Based Features (2022)
Dataset: Movie-MUSNOMIX, MUSAN, GTZAN, Scheirer-Slaney (various durations and sampling rates)
Models: CNN (4 convolutional layers, max pooling), DNN (Adam optimizer), SVM
Features: MFCC from Hilbert Envelope of Group Delay, Modified Group Delay Cepstral Coefficient, Instantaneous Frequency Cosine Coefficient
Classification Method: Deep Neural Network (DNN) and CNN with combined features, Naive Bayes, SVM
Accuracy / Results: 99.81% accuracy combining magnitude and phase-based features with CNN
Key Contributions / Findings: Combining phase-based and magnitude-based features enhanced the accuracy of CNN for speech/music/noise classification

Paper: Speech/Music Classification using MFCC and KNN (2017)
Dataset: Custom dataset of 600 audio clips (1-10s each)
Accuracy / Results: 91% accuracy using KNN for speech/music classification
Key Contributions / Findings: KNN with simple MFCC features proved to be an efficient approach for distinguishing speech from music in short audio clips
